svg.aria-label: Constructed C 1s region with teaching areas 6500, 2200 and 1300 counts s⁻¹ eV, common Gaussian sigma 0.48 eV and 0.4 s dwell per point. Upper panels show observations and fits; lower panels show observed-minus-fitted residuals. The two-component model omits a known contribution.
